item.title: Liquid Network lost $320M in BTC via Elements software bug; attacker returned $268M and retained $47M.
Circle launched Arc mainnet with BlackRock, DTCC, Visa, and Mastercard as founding validators; 10B ARC tokens minted.
21 major banks including Bank of America, Citi, Goldman Sachs, and Fidelity announced a jointly-issued USD stablecoin for H1 2027.
Deutsche Bank announced regulated BTC and ETH custody for European institutional clients by year-end, pending BaFin approval.
SEC proposed Regulation Crypto Assets to create the first tailored offering framework for crypto investment contracts.
CFTC submitted crypto markets and transactions rulemaking to White House for review after Senate failed to advance the Clarity Act.
Coinbase partnered with Stablecore to offer crypto custody, trading, and stablecoin payments to 3,000+ community banks and credit unions.
Block filed for an OCC national trust bank charter for digital asset custody and stablecoin services.
SEC proposed modernizing transfer agent rules to permit distributed ledger technology as the official securities ownership record.
SEC and CFTC issued joint interpretation clarifying how federal securities and commodities laws apply to crypto assets.
Spot ether ETFs attracted $9.3 billion in net inflows over July and August as institutional allocations to Ethereum funds accelerated.
JPMorgan is exploring launching a proprietary USD stablecoin for institutional payments and settlement.
Attackers stole more than $116 million in bitcoin by exploiting a firmware vulnerability in Coldcard hardware wallets.
EU MiCA transitional period expired July 1, requiring all crypto-asset service providers to hold full authorization to operate in the bloc.
